description: Iowa City, IA – Today, Ob-GynPAC announces its support of Christina Bohannan for Iowa’s 1st District. Ob-GynPAC is the only federal PAC dedicated exclusively to electing representatives who support obstetrics and gynecology, and is the political arm of the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG).
